title: My Inventions
author: Nikola Tesla
reference: I. My Early Life, opening sentence (1919)
text: The progressive development of man is vitally dependent on invention.

title: Tao Teh King
author: Lao-tse; translation by James Legge
text: The first is gentleness; the second is economy; and the third is shrinking from taking precedence of others.
